prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A modern, minimalist studio scene featuring two adult men and a white electric bicycle. The central subject stands slightly off-center, facing the camera, wearing a black t-shirt, gray pants, and a white baseball cap with a black brim. He is focused on the bicycle, gently holding the seat with both hands, as if adjusting or inspecting it. The bicycle is sleek and contemporary, with thick black tires, a simple frame, and visible mechanical details, positioned in profile to showcase its design.

To the left, another man in similar attire—black t-shirt and dark pants—stands near the edge of the frame, partially in shadow, holding a blue cloth and a tool, suggesting maintenance or assembly work. The background is a seamless, high-key white cyclorama, creating a clean, uncluttered look that emphasizes the subjects and the bike. The lighting is soft and diffuse, eliminating harsh shadows and lending a professional, commercial quality to the image.

The color palette is restrained, dominated by monochromatic tones—black, white, and gray—with subtle accents from the bike’s yellow reflectors and the blue cloth. The composition is balanced, with the bicycle as the focal point and the two men providing context and narrative. The overall style is crisp and contemporary, reminiscent of product photography or a behind-the-scenes look at a commercial shoot, with a slight documentary feel due to the candid posture and natural interaction of the subjects. The camera angle is eye-level, with a moderate depth of field that keeps all elements in sharp focus, enhancing the clarity and detail of the scene.
